The user wants to restore the exact state of the editor when reopening a project: cursor position, open files, and visible/closed side panels.
I have already investigated the cursor position (T1, T2, T3).
T3 confirmed that the cursor position is saved and restored via `Editor Snapshot` (which contains `Multi Cursor` -> `Cursor Pos`) and pushed to `undo stack` / `redo stack` in `Editor Buffer`.
The claim has two other parts: "qué archivos tenía abiertos" (which files were open) and "si tenía algún panel lateral visible o cerrado" (if
